q: How do we count a solar carport at our factory?
title: Solar carport at a factory
short: Like rooftop solar: power you make and use on site never appears on the grid bill, so Scope 2 falls with no certificate needed. Read generation from the inverter to show the saving. Building the carport is Scope 3 Category 2 in the year you buy it.

ul: Monthly generation from the inverter or meter.
Exported units under net metering follow the discom's rules.

p: If the carport feeds EV chargers, that use is on-site solar too. Keep charger logs.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
